Dates now come out zero-padded everywhere, so March 5 shows as `2026-03-05`. All 4 tests pass, including the existing report header test.

The bug was in three places that built dates by hand from `getUTCMonth() + 1` and `getUTCDate()` with no padding:
- `report.js` (the "Report for ..." header)
- `email.js` (the invoice reminder subject)
- `export.js` (the CSV date column)

I added `dates.js` with a `formatDate` helper that pads month and day, and all three files now call it. I also added `test/dates.test.js`, which checks the helper and the email and CSV output.
